name: Settings
layerWhy: It is a place: sections of settings, each a cell, serving the journey of changing how the product works.
promise: Each section has its own address; changes are saved as they are made.
expectation: Sections at the side, the section's settings beside them.
evidence: A switch says "Saved" beside itself; a form says it on its button; the irreversible sits apart behind a confirmation.
behaviour: On a phone the sections sit above as a row.
relationships: Next two moves: the other sections, Save Changes at the end of a form.
accessibility: The current section is marked aria-current.
failures: Never loses a change on leaving.
dont: One giant Save for every section.
